Treat U2 (GitHub centralized registry) and U6 (HDFS default distributed registry) as complementary solutions: U2 for team-shared, version-controlled registries and U6 as the default local distributed store

activities.activity_description: Set up the local development environment, clone the Spring XD core repository, build it, and study the existing module/spi packages, the Flo parser module, the xd-shell, the stream lifecycle code, and the existing custom-modules distribution to gain the context needed for the user stories.

activities.activity_name: U1 - gpfdist module analysis and dependency mapping
activities.activity_description: Inspect the existing reactor-based gpfdist sink in the spring-xd-modules repository, identify its dependencies, public API, and configuration surface, and map how it must adapt to the core module SPI.

activities.activity_name: U1 - gpfdist code migration to core
activities.activity_description: Move the gpfdist source files into the core project, adapt package layout, update imports, refactor any direct references to the spring-xd-modules SPI into the equivalent core constructs, and expose the sink as a built-in XD sink.
Update Gradle build files to include the new gpfdist module, adjust dependency coordinates, remove stale entries from spring-xd-modules, and ensure the artifact is part of the standard distribution.

activities.activity_name: U1 - gpfdist unit and integration testing
activities.activity_description: Write unit tests for the migrated sink and an integration test that wires it into a stream writing to a local GPDB/HAWQ instance, verifying successful message delivery and error handling.

Design the architecture for a GitHub-backed module registry: repository layout, content addressing for module artifacts, metadata format, authentication model, and sync protocol (push on upload, pull on container startup and periodically).

Implement the new ModuleRegistry SPI implementation that reads module metadata and artifacts from a configured GitHub repository, including token-based authentication, content retrieval, and local caching.

activities.activity_name: U2 - Sync and upload mechanism implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement the upload path so that the admin server commits new module artifacts and metadata to the GitHub repository, and the pull/sync path so that all admin servers and XD containers stay in sync with the shared registry.
Write unit tests using a mocked GitHub client and an integration test against a real test repository to verify upload, sync, authentication errors, and concurrent access across multiple XD nodes.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Rackspace infrastructure provisioning and cluster setup
activities.activity_description: Provision XD container nodes on Rackspace, install the required software (JDK, XD, RabbitMQ), and bring up a representative multi-node cluster for benchmarking.

activities.activity_name: U3 - Rabbit benchmark execution and analysis
activities.activity_description: Author/run benchmark scenarios that increase the number of XD container nodes and measure Rabbit throughput/latency, then collect results and write a brief analysis of scaling behavior.

activities.activity_name: U4 - Flo parser endpoint analysis and error reporting design
activities.activity_description: Review the existing Flo parser REST endpoints, catalogue current error responses, and design a streamlined error reporting strategy (consistent error model, codes, and messages).

activities.activity_name: U4 - Flo parser error reporting implementation
activities.activity_description: Refactor the Flo parser endpoints to emit the new structured error responses, add validation hooks so syntax/semantic errors are reported consistently, and ensure backwards-compatible response codes for unchanged cases.
Add unit tests for the parser and controller layer covering the new error responses and update existing integration tests that asserted on the old response shape.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Mail source SSL/TLS configuration support
activities.activity_description: Extend the Mail source configuration to accept a <util:properties/> bean (or equivalent) via the java-mail-properties attribute so users can set SSL/TLS properties (socket factory class, fallback, store protocol, etc.) for IMAP and SMTP.

activities.activity_name: U5 - Mail source testing with secured servers
activities.activity_description: Write unit tests with mocked JavaMail sessions and an integration test against a secured IMAP/SMTP server verifying that SSL/TLS is correctly applied and that misconfiguration produces clear errors.

activities.activity_name: U6 - HDFS default module registry implementation
activities.activity_description: Change the default location for the custom module registry to an HDFS path, implement the corresponding HDFS-backed ModuleRegistry, and ensure the xd-shell and REST-API can upload/list modules to/from HDFS.

activities.activity_name: U6 - YARN distribution cleanup and upload API updates
activities.activity_description: Remove the custom-modules.zip artifact from the YARN distribution packaging, update assembly descriptors, and adjust any admin REST endpoints that referenced the zip-based custom module path.

Add unit tests using a MiniHDFS cluster and integration tests verifying that the xd-shell and REST-API correctly upload and resolve modules from HDFS and that the YARN distribution no longer contains custom-modules.zip.
Design the auto-configuration mechanism for xd-shell: an init file location convention, supported directives (admin server, hadoop namenode, etc.), and how the shell loads and runs it at startup.

activities.activity_name: U7 - Shell init file processing implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement init file discovery (e.g., /etc/springxd/conf/xd-shell.init) and execution within the xd-shell startup using the existing 'script --file' command path so the documented init file syntax works out of the box.

Add unit tests covering init file discovery and execution, including the cases of missing file, unreadable file, and a file containing multiple directives, and ensure shell output reflects successful auto-configuration.

Design the graceful undeploy flow: how the undeploy signal is propagated to the source and sink, how the in-flight message count is tracked, and how the stream waits for completion (or a configurable timeout) before stopping.

Implement the graceful shutdown: add lifecycle hooks and message channel interceptors, ensure in-flight messages are tracked, have the source stop producing and the sink drain before the container shuts down, and avoid sending messages to the DLQ during a graceful undeploy.

Add unit tests for the in-flight tracking and drain logic, and integration tests that undeploy a stream mid-processing and verify that all messages reach the sink (including the archive extraction custom module scenario from the user story).

Run a multi-feature integration pass that exercises the new gpfdist sink, the HDFS/GitHub registries, the secure mail source, the auto-configured xd-shell, and graceful shutdown together on a single XD cluster to catch interaction regressions.

Update reference documentation: gpfdist sink usage, new module registry options (GitHub and HDFS), secure Mail source configuration examples, xd-shell init file usage, and graceful shutdown behavior and configuration.
